auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to access the console.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} second(s).

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.subtitleForced: First login: choose a password before using the app.

errors.tooSimple: At least 1 letter and 1 digit required.
errors.envLocked: Password is set via env var (legacy mode): remove AUTH_PASSWORD_HASH from the container and restart to change it here.

dashboard.title: Dashboard

imageMissing.title: Photo unavailable
imageMissing.body: No option codes available. Set TESLAMATE_ENCRYPTION_KEY (Tesla API) or TESLA_VEHICLE_OPTIONS (fallback) in your environment to display the vehicle photo. See .env.example.

api.title: Image generated from the option codes returned by the Tesla API (cached).

env.title: Image generated from the TESLA_VEHICLE_OPTIONS environment variable.

dashboard.privacyCheckHint: Import “Charging Data.csv” from the Tesla Privacy export
dashboard.privacyCheckStatus: {n, plural, =0 {No discrepancy} one {# discrepancy to fix} other {# discrepancies to fix}} · imported {date}

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.subtitle: Nominatim addresses associated with drives and charges.

hints.displayName: Text shown on detail page (max 512 chars).
hints.osmReadOnly: These OSM identifiers are indexed: changing them does not update the matching Nominatim record.
hints.rawPaste: Paste a Nominatim JSON payload. Validated via JSON.parse on both client and server.

delete.title: Delete this address?
delete.description: {drives} drive(s) and {charging} charging process(es) will have their address_id set to NULL. This cannot be undone.

errors.uniqueOsm: Another address already uses this (osm_id, osm_type) pair.
errors.invalidRaw: Raw JSON field is not a valid JSON object.

geoDialog.title: Create an address
geoDialog.description: Pick the closest address from the geocoder suggestions. Fields are filled automatically.
geoDialog.noResults: No address found for this search.

geofences.title: Geofences
geofences.subtitle: User-defined zones to categorise drives and charges.

delete.title: Delete this geofence?
delete.description: {drives} drive(s) and {charging} charging process(es) will have their geofence_id set to NULL. This cannot be undone.

updates.title: Firmware updates
updates.subtitle: History of firmware updates per vehicle.

hints.endDate: Leave blank if the update is still ongoing.
hints.endAfterStart: End date must be greater than or equal to start date.

delete.title: Delete this update?
delete.description: This cannot be undone. The update record will be removed.

errors.endBeforeStart: End date cannot be earlier than start date.
errors.noCar: No vehicle available. Import a car before creating an update.

cars.title: Vehicles
cars.subtitle: Cars tracked by TeslaMate and their settings.
cars.deleteUnavailable: Deletion unavailable: cascading a vehicle delete would wipe the entire history (drives, charges, positions, states, updates). Run this manually in the database if truly required.
cars.readOnlyNotice: This information is collected automatically or managed in TeslaMate. TeslaMateFix displays it read-only.

options.fromApiHint: Option codes returned by GET /api/1/dx/vehicles/options, cached to generate the photo.
options.fromEnvHint: Fallback codes used when the API is unavailable (TESLA_VEHICLE_OPTIONS).
options.apiUnavailable: No cached API response for this vehicle.

hints.displayPriority: Lower numbers are shown first in views that support multiple cars.
hints.efficiency: Wh per km. Updated automatically by TeslaMate from drives.
hints.suspendMin: Delay before TeslaMate stops polling to let the car sleep (default 21 min).
hints.suspendAfterIdleMin: Required idle time before attempting to suspend (default 15 min).
hints.reqNotUnlocked: If enabled, TeslaMate will only try to suspend when the vehicle is locked.
hints.useStreamingApi: Subscribes to the Tesla streaming API for drives.
hints.lfpBattery: Tick if the battery is LFP (lithium iron phosphate). Affects SOC computation.

hints.language: TeslaMate language code (e.g. fr, en). Separate from the TeslaMateFix UI locale.
hints.baseUrl: Public URL of the TeslaMate instance (used in notifications).

states.title: States
states.subtitle: online / offline / asleep history per vehicle.

hints.endDate: Leave blank if the state is still ongoing.
hints.endAfterStart: End date must be greater than or equal to start date.
hints.openState: Only one state can stay open (no end date) per vehicle at a time.

closePrevious.label: Automatically close the previous state
closePrevious.description: A state is still open for this vehicle. Tick this box to close it at 1 second before the new state.

delete.title: Delete this state?
delete.description: This cannot be undone. The state record will be removed.

errors.endBeforeStart: End date cannot be earlier than start date.
errors.openStateExists: A state is already open for this vehicle. Tick "close previous" or set an end date.
errors.noCar: No vehicle available. Import a car before creating a state.

drives.title: Drives
drives.subtitle: Drives recorded by TeslaMate (origin → destination).

map.noTrack: No GPS positions to draw this trip.

compute.hint: Fill the start address, end address and start date/time to enable the calculation.
compute.editHint: Computed values are indicative: adjust them freely if the actual drive differs from the theoretical one.
compute.positionsHint: Positions are regenerated on each “Compute” click (not affected by your edits above).

startState.title: Start state
startState.description: No position was found before this date/time. Enter the start state to compute the drive.
startState.needed: No prior position: enter the start state, then run the calculation again.

drives.filtersHint: Filter by vehicle and date range to narrow the result.

delete.title: Delete this drive?
delete.description: This cannot be undone. Associated positions will keep drive_id set to NULL (FK SET NULL).

errors.endBeforeStart: End date cannot be earlier than start date.
errors.addressRequired: Start and end addresses are required.
errors.noCar: No vehicle available. Import a car before creating a drive.

positionsTab.truncated: Only the first {cap} positions are loaded.
positionsTab.empty: No position attached to this drive.

recalc.title: Recompute from positions
recalc.description: Reads every position attached to this drive and recomputes distance (Haversine), duration, ascent/descent (sum of elevation deltas) and max speed.

applyConfirm.title: Apply recompute?
applyConfirm.description: Current values will be overwritten with computed values. Reversible only via re-compute or manual edit.

correction.recomputeDescription: Recomputes all drive fields (boundaries, odometer, ranges, power, temperatures, distance/duration/elevation, addresses/geofences) and links the trailing positions, from the drive's positions.
correction.noPositions: No linked positions: automatic fix impossible (edit or delete manually).
correction.absorbed: {count} trailing position(s) will be linked to this drive.

reasons.positionsBeyondEnd: Some positions are dated after the recorded end.

applyConfirm.title: Apply the fix?
applyConfirm.description: Boundaries (dates, positions, odometer, ranges), metrics and start/end addresses/geofences will be reconstructed from the drive's positions. Reversible via recompute or manual edit.

positions.afterMissing: No position found after the end date: the start position will be used for the end tick.
positions.editedHint: values edited (new position will be created)

warnings.acLimitedTo11kW: Tesla cars typically cap AC charging at 11 kW, even on a 22 kW station.

hints.chargeEnergyAdded: Visible in the Tesla app (rounded to kWh).
hints.chargeEnergyUsed: Energy billed by the station. May be missing if the car had no network.
hints.chargerTypeChangeWillUpdateTicks: Changing this will update {n} ticks and reset brand / cable / type.
hints.applyAllDisabled: Disabled: the session has {count} reliable intermediate ticks, only the last tick is corrected.

warnings.chargerTypeMixed: Inconsistent type: ticks mix AC and DC. Display falls back to the last tick.

delete.title: Delete this session?
delete.description: {n} measurement(s) will be removed in cascade. This cannot be undone.

errors.endBeforeStart: End date cannot be earlier than start date.
errors.noCar: No vehicle available. Import a car before creating a charge.
errors.noPosition: No position available for this vehicle. Create one first.
errors.endBatteryLowerThanStart: End battery level must be greater than or equal to start level.
errors.startDateInFuture: Start date cannot be in the future.
errors.overlapsSession: Overlaps another charging session of the same vehicle.
errors.invalidChargerPower: Power not supported for this charger type.
errors.invalidContext: Could not prepare the session context.
errors.noPositionBefore: No position recorded before the start date for this vehicle. Import a GPS position before creating this session.
errors.startAfterSecondTick: Start must be before the second tick ({tick}).
errors.endBeforeOrEqualPenultimateTick: End must be after the second-to-last tick ({tick}).

deleteOne.title: Delete this measurement?
deleteOne.description: Tick #{id} will be removed. Parent aggregates are NOT recomputed automatically.

recalc.title: Recompute from measurements
recalc.description: Reads the measurements (charges) of this session and recomputes added energy (max), duration (max - min) and battery levels (first / last tick).

applyConfirm.title: Apply recompute?
applyConfirm.description: Current values will be overwritten with computed values.

costHint.noTariff: No tariff on geofence “{geofence}”: enter the cost manually.
costHint.noGeofence: No geofence: enter the cost manually.

rangesFromSoc.unavailable: Ranges can't be computed: no usable history around this date.

estimateToast.missingEnergy: Fill in added energy before estimating.

positions.title: Positions
positions.subtitle: Raw GPS points. Very high volume — filter before query.
positions.filtersRequired: Filter first to avoid a massive query: pick a vehicle + date range (<= 31 days), or a specific drive.
positions.filterError: Date range too wide: max 31 days.

map.empty: No position to display for this filter.
map.tableLimited: Table limited to 31 days — narrow the range; the map shows the full period.

delete.title: Delete this position?
delete.description: This cannot be undone. If this position is referenced by a drive (start/end_position_id), the FK will become NULL; if it is referenced by a charge (position_id NOT NULL), deletion will fail.

many.title: Delete {n} position(s)?
many.description: This cannot be undone. References (drives.start/end_position_id) will be set to NULL. Positions linked to a charge cannot be deleted.

delete.referencedByCharge: This position is referenced by a charge (FK NOT NULL): deletion refused.

origin.title: Position origin

descriptions.vehicle_data: Fleet API vehicle_data call: ranges, temperatures, tyres and climate filled in.
descriptions.flux: Fleet Telemetry frame: protocol columns only (position, speed, power, SOC, odometer, elevation).
descriptions.flux_complete: Stream frame completed afterwards by TeslaMateAPI (D13 FILL).
descriptions.d13: Position created by a TeslaMateAPI reconstruction (D13: EXTEND, CREATE, SPLIT…).

origin.reconstructedWarning: {n} position(s) reconstructed or completed by TeslaMateAPI: computed data, check before a manual correction.
origin.columnsOnly: Origin inferred from filled columns only: details unavailable without TeslaMateAPI (a completed stream looks like Fleet API, a reconstruction cannot be identified).

privacy.title: Check against the Tesla export
privacy.subtitle: Compares the charging sessions seen by the car (Tesla Privacy export) with those recorded by TeslaMate.

import.title: Import “Charging Data.csv”
import.help: Request your data from Tesla (data privacy section of your tesla.com account), unzip the archive with the password sent by Tesla, then pick “Charging Data/Charging Data.csv”. Successive imports are merged.

clear.title: Clear Tesla imports?
clear.description: Imported sessions are removed from the working directory (var/). The TeslaMate database is not modified.

privacy.readOnly: Read-only mode: the report is available but corrections are disabled.
privacy.unknownVins: Vehicles in the export unknown to TeslaMate (ignored): {vins}
privacy.toFix: {n, plural, one {# discrepancy to fix} other {# discrepancies to fix}}.
privacy.allGood: Nothing to fix: TeslaMate matches Tesla over the imported period.

kindsHelp.missing: Charges seen by Tesla but missing in TeslaMate (network loss, TeslaMate stopped…). “Minor” charges are below 0.5 kWh.
kindsHelp.fragmented: One Tesla charge recorded as several TeslaMate sessions.
kindsHelp.energy_mismatch: Same charge on both sides but different energy added (beyond 0.5 kWh and 5%).
kindsHelp.extra: TeslaMate sessions with no match in the Tesla export.
kindsHelp.ok: Energy added matches within 0.5 kWh or 5%.

advice.missing: Create the session with the wizard, prefilled with Tesla's dates and {tesla}.
advice.fragmented: Close sessions left open (Recalc tab), delete empty fragments and check the energy (difference {diff}).
advice.energy_mismatch: Open the session and check the energy added: Tesla reports {tesla} (difference {diff}).
advice.extra: To check: session missing from the Tesla export.
advice.extraEmpty: Empty session (0 kWh, under 2 min): delete it.
